## Scope and permission

Issue / ADR / branch / authorized GO (if any):

- [ ] Docs/research only (current scope)
- [ ] R0 disposable fixture: link separately approved GO
- [ ] R1–R7: link separately approved GO

## Evidence

SHA and source; tests run vs NOT_RUN; E2E status; negative scenarios; CPU/RAM budget; privacy; Ravum touched? (must be NO in Flow scope).

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No unratified ADR marked accepted
- [ ] No license or source-code extraction without rights
- [ ] No silent masking of FAILED/UNKNOWN/ST​ALE/E2E
- [ ] No destructive user working-tree operation
